  • Alta

    IKON

    Utah, USA

    Season Opens Wed Nov 25 ↗

    What's new

    • Projected opening day moved to Wed Nov 25, conditions permitting ↗
    • Uphill travel on the mountain is closed; the Summer Road remains open for uphill access ↗
    • The renovated Albion Day Lodge opens with the season Nov 25, with a new east wing and 198 new lockers ↗

    No upcoming events posted

  • Arapahoe Basin

    IKON

    Colorado, USA

    Season Opens Wed Oct 28 ↗

    What's new

    • Now open 7 days a week for as long as possible ↗
    • Uphill access to the summit opened Nov 20 from 4pm, outside lift hours; a pass is required ↗
    • Lenawee Express opened Nov 20, bringing summit-to-base skiing and riding ↗

  • Aspen Snowmass

    IKON

    Colorado, USA

    Season Opens Thu Nov 26 ↗

    What's new

    • The brand-new Ullrhof reopens its doors this winter season ↗
    • Aspen Skiing Co. will run Bonnie's on Aspen Mountain after this season, with no big changes planned ↗
    • Nell Bell passed its state load test and is certified to carry riders ↗

  • Banff Sunshine

    IKON

    Alberta, Canada

    Season Opens Sat Nov 7 ↗

    What's new

    • Strawberry hike park was built for the Nov 7 opening, with rails, tubes, boxes and a beginner pole jam ↗
    • Strawberry Express opened for the season Nov 14, starting with one run off the lift ↗
    • Coco Lounge has reopened on the Centennial Day Lodge deck in the village ↗

  • Beaver Creek

    EPIC

    Colorado, USA

    Season Opens Wed Nov 25 ↗

    What's new

    • First snow-stake reading of the season showed about 5 inches; snowmaking is running up top ↗
    • Snowmaking reached the Birds of Prey finish arena, using 16 new snow guns on the lower course ↗
    • It was snowing at all elevations across the resort on Nov 14 ↗

  • Big Bear Mountain Resort

    IKON

    California, USA

    Season Dates not announced yet

    What's new

    • Snowmaking has begun in the Snow Valley base area ↗
    • Fresh snow fell overnight into Nov 17 at Snow Summit ↗
    • All three mountains had a good night of snowmaking into Nov 18 ↗

    No upcoming events posted

  • Big Sky

    IKON

    Montana, USA

    Season Opens Wed Nov 25 ↗

    What's new

    • M by the Alinea Group culinary residency returns, opening Dec 10 ↗
    • The learning center has a new home steps from the Explorer Gondola mid-station ↗
    • Snowmaking hit a record snowgun count and flow rate this week, 5 days before opening ↗

    No upcoming events posted

  • Breckenridge

    EPIC

    Colorado, USA

    Season Opens Wed Nov 11 ↗

    What's new

    • Opened Nov 11 on Peak 8, with Springmeier served by the Colorado SuperChair ↗
    • Five Chair started spinning Sat Nov 14, joining the Colorado SuperChair ↗
    • Rip's Ride, Five Chair and the Peak 8 Ski and Ride School are open for beginner skiers and riders ↗

  • Brighton

    IKON

    Utah, USA

    Season Opens Tue Nov 24 ↗

    What's new

    • The Bone Zone opened Nov 17, 10am-3pm; enter by walking around the Milly Lift ↗
    • Uphill travel is prohibited (red light) and runs are off limits during snowmaking ↗
    • Opens Tue Nov 24 for its 90th season, with Majestic and Explorer running 9am-4pm ↗

    No upcoming events posted

  • Copper Mountain

    IKON

    Colorado, USA

    Season Opens Sun Nov 8 ↗

    What's new

    • Opening terrain: American Eagle to Rhapsody, Fair Play and Main Vein; no green terrain at first ↗
    • Uphill travel is closed; uphill access is expected to open in mid-December ↗
    • Opened for the 26/27 season on Sunday, Nov 8 ↗

  • Deer Valley

    IKON

    Utah, USA

    Season Opens Sat Dec 5 ↗

    What's new

    • 2026/27 adds the Hail Peak Express chairlift, seven new runs and 200 more skiable acres ↗
    • Daily skier numbers are capped; Ikon Pass holders must reserve ski days in advance ↗
    • 12+ inches fell in 24 hours to Nov 20, ahead of the Dec 5 opening ↗

  • Heavenly

    EPIC

    California, USA

    Season Opens Fri Nov 20 ↗

    What's new

    • Snowmaking is underway for the season ↗
    • Gondola sightseeing and Mountain Coaster open early Sat Nov 14, weather permitting; skiing opens Nov 20 ↗
    • Opened Nov 20 via Gunbarrel and the Tram; parking at Cal Base needs no reservation ↗

    No upcoming events posted

  • Jackson Hole

    IKON

    Wyoming, USA

    Season Opens Fri Nov 27 ↗

    What's new

    • 3 more inches fell in Rendezvous Bowl overnight, a month before opening day ↗
    • Almost two feet of new snow fell on Rendezvous Mountain over three days of storms ↗

  • Keystone

    EPIC

    Colorado, USA

    Season Opens Fri Oct 30 ↗

    What's new

    • Spring Dipper to Montezuma opens Nov 20, taking open terrain past 110 acres ↗
    • Snow tubing opens with one lane Mon Nov 23, adding lanes as conditions allow ↗
    • Parking is free at River Run Village and Mountain House East; Mountain House West is paid ↗

  • Killington

    IKON

    Vermont, USA

    Season Opens Tue Nov 17 ↗

    What's new

    • New Snowdon Quad has chairs on the line and lift houses built; new Learn To Carpet is in place ↗
    • 165 snow guns are running; Superstar is being prepped for the Killington Cup ↗
    • Opening Day Nov 17 for Killington, Beast 365 and Ikon pass holders; open to the public from Nov 18 ↗

  • Lake Louise

    IKON

    Alberta, Canada

    Season Opens Sun Nov 1 ↗

    What's new

    • Terrain park is open early, with a jump line and six rails and boxes ↗
    • Kuma Yama reopens for the winter season Nov 18, serving sushi and ramen with a new menu ↗
    • Grizzly Express Gondola opened Nov 19, with Deer Run and part of Eagle Meadows ↗

    No upcoming events posted

  • Mammoth Mountain

    IKON

    California, USA

    Season Opens Thu Nov 5 ↗

    What's new

    • Opened for the 2026/27 season on Nov 5 ↗
    • 2-4 feet of new snow fell over Nov 19-20, and terrain is expanding daily ↗
    • Canyon Lodge and the Village Gondola open for the winter season Sat Nov 21; lifts not before 9am ↗

  • Mt. Bachelor

    IKON

    Oregon, USA

    Season Opens Fri Dec 4 ↗

    What's new

    • Trailhead Lodge Cafe & Bar is open daily, 8am to 8pm ↗
    • Plans to open Dec 4, or sooner if conditions allow ↗
    • Snowmaking started for the season the night of Nov 15 ↗

  • Northstar

    EPIC

    California, USA

    Season Opens Fri Nov 20 ↗

    What's new

    • Snowmaking system tested overnight Oct 23, including new software upgrades ↗
    • Opening day Nov 20: Vista, Arrow, Big Easy and Comstock, reached by Big Springs Gondola ↗
    • Parking reservations are not required until Dec 12 ↗

    No upcoming events posted

  • Palisades Tahoe

    IKON

    California, USA

    Season Opens Sat Nov 21 ↗

    What's new

    • Opens Nov 21 with Gold Coast, Sunkid 1 and the Funitel (ride only), plus Treeline Cirque at Alpine ↗
    • Base to Base Gondola links both mountains from Nov 21, with no offload at KT ↗
    • Over 5 feet of snow fell on the upper mountain in the 7 days before opening ↗

  • Park City

    EPIC

    Utah, USA

    Season Dates not announced yet

    What's new

    • Ski & Ride School is now in the My Epic app, with digital check-in and lesson updates ↗
    • Opening day is pushed back from Nov 20; a new date will be announced when the mountain is ready ↗

  • Revelstoke

    IKON

    British Columbia, Canada

    Season Opens Sat Dec 5 ↗

    What's new

    • Opening day is Dec 5; early-season lifts start at 9 or 9:30am and close 3 to 3:30pm ↗
    • The lower gondola got a brand-new haul rope this fall, and the grooming fleet was expanded ↗

  • Snowbird

    IKON

    Utah, USA

    Season Opens Fri Nov 27 ↗

    What's new

    • 17 inches of new snow fell over the Oct 31-Nov 1 weekend, and it was still snowing Nov 2 ↗
    • Snowmaking has started for the season after fresh snow ↗
    • 18 inches fell in 48 hours to Nov 18, with more on the way before the Nov 27 opening ↗

  • Solitude

    IKON

    Utah, USA

    Season Opens Thu Nov 19 ↗

    What's new

    • Opened Nov 19 with the Link chairlift and park features on Easy Street ↗
    • Parking is free through Dec 17 ↗
    • Moonbeam opened for the season Nov 20 ↗

  • Steamboat

    IKON

    Colorado, USA

    Season Opens Fri Nov 27 ↗

    What's new

    • New beginner trail Barrow's Bend links Rendezvous to South Peak and Sunshine Express lifts ↗
    • Opening day moved to Fri Nov 27 after a warm stretch; crews need more cold nights for snowmaking ↗

  • Stowe

    EPIC

    Vermont, USA

    Season Dates not announced yet

    What's new

    • The Lookout Double is now Fletcher's Lookout, honoring 45 years of lift maintenance by Mark Fletcher ↗
    • Snowmaking started Nov 10 on the upper half of the mountain ↗
    • The planned Nov 21 opening is off; base temps near 40°F, so Stowe opens when conditions allow ↗

    No upcoming events posted

  • Tremblant

    IKON

    Quebec, Canada

    Season Opens Thu Nov 26 ↗

    What's new

    • New snow groomers for the 2026-27 season arrived at Tremblant ↗
    • Snowmaking began at the summit and on P'tit Bonheur, about two weeks before opening ↗
    • Direct YUL airport shuttle to Tremblant is back, Thursday to Sunday until April 4, 2027 ↗

  • Vail

    EPIC

    Colorado, USA

    Season Opens Fri Nov 13 ↗

    What's new

    • Swingsville opened Nov 18; the hike-to park moved to the bottom of Meadows, off Ramshorn ↗
    • Beginner terrain opens Nov 21 via the Eagle Bahn Gondola from Lionshead, which runs 9am-3:30pm ↗
    • Forest Flyer Mountain Coaster runs in winter for the first time, from Nov 21, 11am-3:30pm ↗

  • Whistler Blackcomb

    EPIC

    British Columbia, Canada

    Season Opens Fri Nov 20 ↗

    What's new

    • New Showcase Chairlift is in testing, aiming to open before the Christmas break if conditions allow ↗
    • Hiking into 7th Heaven, Glacier Express or Crystal Chair terrain is not permitted for now ↗
    • Blackcomb opened Nov 20 to start the season; Whistler Mountain is set to open next week ↗

  • Winter Park

    IKON

    Colorado, USA

    Season Opens Fri Nov 13 ↗

    What's new

    • New Rope Drop Lanes this season for Rope Drop Club members ↗
    • Opened for winter 26/27 on Fri Nov 13, with first chair at 9am ↗
